Crème De Brie Apple Pinwheels
By: Corrinne
Published: Tuesday, November 9, 2010 - 9:03am

Ingredients




3 tablespoons honey mustard
1 package (5 oz.) Alouette Crème de Brie, Original
1 large flour tortilla (10 – 12 inch)
6 slices of high quality ham or prosciutto
2 apples, sliced and brushed with lemon juice
1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts

Preparation

1 Spread honey mustard on entire tortilla. 2 Spread Alouette Crème de Brie on ¾ of tortilla. 3 Layer with ham slices and top with apples and nuts on same ¾ section of tortilla. 4 Roll jelly-roll fashion and slice into 1 inch pinwheels.
